decisions.reason: A net price display plugin costs little to maintain in a marketplace listing, and its demand from B2B shop clients is still uncertain, so keeping the option open is cheap.
An ERP interface plugin supports the firm's end-to-end and multichannel strategy and its integration projects, so it has high strategic option value at low holding cost.
Price comparison tracking ties directly to the firm's measurable marketing services, and after only one year the evidence is too thin to justify abandoning it.
This tracking variant overlaps with C and E, so consolidation is possible, but its upkeep cost is minimal and its prospects are not yet resolved.
As a third similar tracking plugin it is the most likely target of consolidation, but cheap maintenance favours keeping it until its usage is clearer.
A net price reporting plugin complements the firm's analytics offering, costs little to host, and has had too little time to show whether it will pay off.
